Dendrophryniscus berthalutzae: The Results heading and Table1 say berthalutzae, but Figure4 caption says brevipollicatus. The minimum-frequency SD is printed as 0.04 Hz despite a 2842–2972 Hz range. Neither is silently corrected or used to transfer the call to another accepted species.
结果标题及表 1 写 berthalutzae，图 4 图注却写 brevipollicatus；最低频率标准差印为 0.04 Hz，范围却为 2842–2972 Hz。两项均不静默更正，也不据此把鸣叫转移给另一接受种。
Melanophryniscus alipioi: Table1 says Ponta Grossa, whereas Figure5 caption says Campina Grande do Sul. The recorded locality conflict is not resolved here.
表 1 写 Ponta Grossa，图 5 图注写 Campina Grande do Sul，这里不自行解决录音地点冲突。
Melanophryniscus moreirae: Table1 lists three males and 30 analyzed calls; the Results divide 14 series and 16 isolated notes, each labelled two males. The text does not identify which individual contributes to each subset; neither count is substituted for the other.
表 1 列三只雄性、30 次分析鸣叫；结果分为 14 个序列及 16 个孤立音符，均标两只雄性。文字没有说明各子集对应哪些个体，两种计数不互相替代。
Ololygon flavoguttata: Table1 lists 29 analyzed calls, whereas Results use 19 and 22 observations for the two types and 29 intervals. These are metric-specific counts whose overlap is not reconstructed here.
表 1 列 29 次分析鸣叫，结果为两种类型分别使用 19 和 22 次观察，并有 29 个间隔。各指标样本可能重叠，这里不重建重叠关系。
Ololygon tripui: The Table1 calls-analyzed field is literally ??; Results provide separate call and note denominators. No total is invented by summing unlike acoustic units.
表 1 的分析鸣叫数原样为 ??；结果另给不同的鸣叫与音符分母。不通过相加不同声学单位来补造总数。
